hard_failure_definitions: FONT_NOT_EMBEDDED: any font with emb = no (a non-embedded core font is the classic case)
FIGURE_NOT_SINGLE_PAGE: a figure PDF whose page count is not 1
TEXT_OUTSIDE_PAGE: a word box more than 1 pt outside the page box AND the rendered page shows the ink is clipped, or the page could not be rendered so the violation is unverified
INK_CLIPPED_AT_PAGE_EDGE: rendered ink reaches within 1 pt of the page edge on a flagged page
TEXT_HEIGHT_BELOW_MINIMUM: the estimated typeset size of the text line carrying the word is below 4.5 pt (the tallest Poppler box on the line estimates the size)
SCHEMATIC_WITHOUT_DRAWIO_SOURCE: a schematic figure with no figures/v17/drawio/<name>.drawio
advisory_definitions: TEXT_BOX_PADDING_ONLY: a word box crosses the page edge but the rendered ink stays inside; a box-model artifact, not a defect
SMALL_RELATIVE_WORD_BOXES: a word box below 0.45 of its own line height (superscript, subscript or a fragment of a rotated run)

overlaps.method_note: conservative approximation of visual overlap: derived from poppler word boxes, which carry font ascent/descent padding and are axis-aligned even for rotated text; it also cannot see text drawn over graphics. Overlaps are reported as warnings, never as hard failures.

merged_label_runs.method_note: a repeated substring inside one word box means adjacent labels were drawn with no space glyph between them, so Poppler cannot split them into separate words; the pairwise overlap test is blind to this and the row reads as one continuous string

overlaps.method_note: conservative approximation of visual overlap: derived from poppler word boxes, which carry font ascent/descent padding and are axis-aligned even for rotated text; it also cannot see text drawn over graphics. Overlaps are reported as warnings, never as hard failures.

merged_label_runs.method_note: a repeated substring inside one word box means adjacent labels were drawn with no space glyph between them, so Poppler cannot split them into separate words; the pairwise overlap test is blind to this and the row reads as one continuous string
